pages.text: A passenger car in maroon lacquer with bronze trim. It rides like a minecart but **won't pick up hostile mobs** unless it has the [[cell_upgrade]].

Hitch it behind a [[locomotive_cart]] with a [[linking_bar]].

A [[mob_filters|mob filter]] chooses which mobs it takes; the [[shimmer_upgrade]] hides its riders; the [[reinforced_cage_upgrade]] lets it carry any mob but the dragon.

On an [[inspector_rail]] it reads 1 empty, 2 with a rider.
